title: Honeycomb A-sandwich radome, six uniaxial layers (Model 3)
source: V. N. Peshlov, P. I. Dankov, B. Hadjistamov, Proc. EuCAP 2006, Nice (ESA SP-626), Table II and Fig. 11
notes: Table II, Model 3: six layers, each uniaxial with its axis normal to the wall: eps_par = eps'_par (1 - j tan d_par) in the plane, eps_perp normal to it, in exp(+jwt), converted here. Free space on both sides. 'Normal polarisation' (NP, E normal to the plane of incidence) is s here; 'parallel' (PP) is p. Insertion loss IL = 20 log|t| = 10 log T for identical outer media. Fig. 11 gives MEASURED IL at 12.5 GHz against angle, with error bars; the paper's own model approximates the anisotropic propagation (its Eqs. 1, 2 and 6), so the comparison here is with the measurements.
